description: Source code for Goteo's API controller managing project messages and comments, including listing, adding, deleting, and mailing functionalities.

classes.name: MessagesApiController
classes.description: Controller handling API endpoints for project messages and comments, including listing, adding, deleting, and mailing functionalities.

methods.name: commentsAction
methods.description: Lists comments for a specific project, with permission check.

methods.name: addCommentAction
methods.description: Adds a new comment or reply to a message thread, with recipient and privacy handling.

methods.name: deleteCommentAction
methods.description: Deletes a specific comment after permission validation.

methods.name: messagesAction
methods.description: Lists all messages for a project, with permission check.

methods.name: userMessagesAction
methods.description: Lists messages for a specific user within a project.

methods.name: addMessageAction
methods.description: Creates a new message associated with a project.

methods.name: projectMailingAction
methods.description: Retrieves mailing statistics and messages for a project.
